target_moa.text: Small molecule inhibitor of phosphodiesterase 3 (PDE3) and phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4); inhibition increases cAMP, leading to airway smooth muscle relaxation with bronchodilation.

citations.quote: Ensifentrine is a small molecule inhibitor of both PDE3 and PDE4. PDE enzymes hydrolyze cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) and cyclic guanosine monophosphate (cGMP) to inactive 5'-nucleotide products.
Ensifentrine, through the inhibition of PDE3 and PDE4, leads to relaxation of airway smooth muscle with bronchodilation.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥1% and more common than placebo) in the pooled 24-week population (N=975 OHTUVAYRE, N=574 placebo): back pain (1.8% vs 1.0%), hypertension (1.7% vs 0.9%), urinary tract infection (1.3% vs 1.0%), and diarrhea (1.0% vs 0.7%). Discontinuations due to AEs were 7.6% vs 8.2% for placebo. Psychiatric events including suicidality were reported.
